summary:
Generated all 8 publication-quality PNG figures (dpi=150) showing per-epoch training loss and validation accuracy curves for a small CNN on Fashion-MNIST across 7 training sizes and 2 augmentation conditions (aug / no-aug), using data from analysis/results_all.csv.

Design details:
- Each per-size figure (2-panel, 10×4 in): left panel = train loss, right panel = val accuracy. Each condition rendered as 2 thin dashed lines (seed 42 & seed 123, α=0.55) plus one thick solid mean line. Blue = No-Aug, Orange = Aug.
- Combined 7-row × 2-col figure (12×28 in, 841 KB) embeds all 7 sizes in ascending order with a unified legend and supertitle.
- All 8 files exist under figures/ and satisfy: individual PNGs ≥ 109 KB (>> 10 KB), combined PNG = 841 KB (>> 100 KB).
